Get those hounds to start earning their keep.|Zorby and Pegla speak via PA and comlink|}} '''Zorby''' was the proprietor of [[Zorby's Western Shiplot]] on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], employing the [[human]] sentry [[Pegla]] as his de facto head of security. In [[5 BBY]], Zorby was in the yard's office and called for a report from Pegla over the PA system after hearing a commotion in the back. Pegla was speaking to his friend [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] in the yard, but, as Andor was not meant to be there, the sentry contacted Zorby via [[comlink]] and claimed instead that [[rat]]s were causing the commotion. Invoking [[Chobb]], Zorby then told Pegla that there was a customer out front and ordered the sentry to use the yard's two [[Corellian hound]]s to deal with the issue. ==Behind the scenes== Zorby's voice is heard in "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]," the first episode of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''{{'s}} [[Andor Season 1|first season]], which was aired on [[September 21]], [[2022]].{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} {{1st}} {{Voice}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Zorby |es=Zorby |fr=Zorby |ja=ゾービー |ka=ზორბი |nl=Zorby }} [[Category:Business owners and executives]] [[Category:Ferrixians]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
